court_cases: Confirmed Indian litigation, all tax/customs (not criminal, not sanctions-related). Party role: appellant/petitioner in each. (1) M/s NTB International Pvt. Ltd. v. Commissioner of Central Excise, Mumbai-II, CESTAT West Zonal Bench, order dated 13 July 2010 (indiankanoon.org search result, full document available). (2) NTB International (P) Ltd. v. Commnr. of Central Excise, Thane, Supreme Court of India, Civil Appeal No. 1296/2005, Bench A.K. Sikri & Rohinton Fali Nariman, record of proceedings 5 May 2015. (3) NTB International Pvt. Ltd. v. Commissioner of C. Ex., CESTAT Mumbai, 30 June 2000, 2000(121) ELT 134 (Tri-Mumbai). (4) NTB International P. Ltd. v. The Commissioner of Customs, CESTAT Mumbai, 23 July 2004, 2004(172) ELT 130 (Tri-Mumbai). (5) CCE, Mumbai v. NTB International Pvt. Ltd., 2014 (302) ELT 481 (Bom) - Bombay High Court, cited in later CESTAT matters. (6) Related clubbing/penalty proceedings: Kamal Kacholia and Ors. v. Commissioner of Central Excise, CESTAT Mumbai, 1 September 2004 (penalty on M/s NTB International reduced from Rs 42,07,807 to Rs 6 lakhs); Polybelt Technologies India v. Commissioner of Central Excise, CESTAT, 13 August 2008 and 20 January 2016 (department treated NTB International as the real manufacturing unit; clubbing of clearances). Status: these are excise/customs classification and valuation disputes; per available records they were decided/remanded at tribunal level. No criminal case, no sanctions prosecution, no regulator action found.
